Skills: python fastapi sqlalchemy postgresql redis docker pytest github actions

# Invoice Service
A billing and invoicing backend service.

## Overview
The service exposes rest apis built with python and fastapi for creating, listing and voiding invoices.
Every endpoint is validated with pydantic models before it reaches the domain layer.

## Architecture
Requests enter through a fastapi router, are handled by a service layer, and persist through sqlalchemy.
The postgresql schema is versioned with alembic migrations and every migration is reversible.
A redis cache fronts the invoice lookup path to keep median latency low.

## Testing
Unit tests run under pytest with fixtures for the database session and the redis client.
Coverage is enforced at eighty percent and the suite runs in continuous integration on every pull request.

## Deployment
The service ships as a docker image and is deployed through github actions.
Health checks and structured logging are wired in before the container is marked ready.

# Rate Limiter
A reusable token bucket rate limiter.

## Overview
A small python library that applies per client request limits to any fastapi application.
Limits are configured declaratively and enforced as middleware.

## Usage
Install the package, register the middleware, and declare a limit per route.
The limiter stores counters in redis so that limits hold across multiple application processes.

## Benchmarks
The limiter adds under one millisecond of overhead per request in local benchmarks.
Benchmarks are reproducible through a pytest benchmark suite committed alongside the library.
